speaker: god
text: Ask, and I will give it to you!
name: The LORD

speaker: solomon
text: You have shown much loving devotion to my father David, and You have made me king in his place.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Now, O LORD God, let Your promise to my father David be fulfilled. For You have made me king over a people as numerous as the dust of the earth.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Now grant me wisdom and knowledge, so that I may lead this people. For who is able to govern this great people of Yours?
name: Solomon

speaker: god
text: Since this was in your heart instead of requesting riches or wealth or glory for yourself or death for your enemies—and since you have not even requested long life but have asked for wisdom and knowledge to govern My people over whom I have made you king—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: therefore wisdom and knowledge have been granted to you. And I will also give you riches and wealth and honor unlike anything given to the kings before you or after you.
name: The LORD

speaker: solomon
text: Do for me as you did for my father David when you sent him cedars to build himself a house to live in.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Behold, I am about to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God to dedicate to Him for burning fragrant incense before Him, for displaying the showbread continuously, and for making burnt offerings every morning and evening as well as on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts of the LORD our God. This is ordained for Israel forever.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: The house that I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: But who is able to build a house for Him, since the heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain Him? Who then am I, that I should build a house for Him, except as a place to burn sacrifices before Him?
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Send me, therefore, a craftsman skilled in engraving to work with gold and silver, with bronze and iron, and with purple, crimson, and blue yarn. He will work with my craftsmen in Judah and Jerusalem, whom my father David provided.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Send me also cedar, cypress, and algum logs from Lebanon, for I know that your servants have skill to cut timber there. And indeed, my servants will work with yours
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: to prepare for me timber in abundance, because the temple I am building will be great and wonderful.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: I will pay your servants, the woodcutters, 20,000 cors of ground wheat, 20,000 cors of barley, 20,000 baths of wine, and 20,000 baths of olive oil.
name: Solomon

speaker: hiram
text: Because the LORD loves His people, He has set you over them as king.
name: Hiram king of Tyre

speaker: hiram
text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who made the heavens and the earth! He has given King David a wise son with insight and understanding, who will build a temple for the LORD and a royal palace for himself.
name: Hiram king of Tyre

speaker: hiram
text: So now I am sending you Huram-abi, a skillful man endowed with creativity.
name: Hiram king of Tyre

speaker: hiram
text: He is the son of a woman from the daughters of Dan, and his father is a man of Tyre. He is skilled in work with gold and silver, bronze and iron, stone and wood, purple, blue, and crimson yarn, and fine linen. He is experienced in every kind of engraving and can execute any design that is given him. He will work with your craftsmen and with those of my lord, your father David.
name: Hiram king of Tyre

speaker: hiram
text: Now let my lord send to his servants the wheat, barley, olive oil, and wine he promised.
name: Hiram king of Tyre

speaker: hiram
text: We will cut logs from Lebanon, as many as you need, and we will float them to you as rafts by sea down to Joppa. Then you can take them up to Jerusalem.
name: Hiram king of Tyre

speaker: levites
text: For He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
name: The singers and priests

speaker: solomon
text: The LORD has said that He would dwell in the thick cloud;
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: and I have built You an exalted house, a place for You to dwell forever.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has fulfilled with His own hand what He spoke with His mouth to my father David, saying,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: ‘Since the day I brought My people out of the land of Egypt, I have not chosen a city from any tribe of Israel in which to build a house so that My Name would be there, nor have I chosen anyone to be ruler over My people Israel.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: But now I have chosen Jerusalem for My Name to be there, and I have chosen David to be over My people Israel.’
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Now it was in the heart of my father David to build a house for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: But the LORD said to my father David, ‘Since it was in your heart to build a house for My Name, you have done well to have this in your heart.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build it; but your son, your own offspring, will build the house for My Name.’
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Now the LORD has fulfilled the word that He spoke. I have succeeded my father David, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised. I have built the house for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: And there I have provided a place for the ark, which contains the covenant of the LORD that He made with the children of Israel.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: O LORD, God of Israel, there is no God like You in heaven or on earth, keeping Your covenant of loving devotion with Your servants who walk before You with all their hearts.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: You have kept Your promise to Your servant, my father David. What You spoke with Your mouth You have fulfilled with Your hand this day.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Therefore now, O LORD, God of Israel, keep for Your servant, my father David, what You promised when You said: ‘You will never fail to have a man to sit before Me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants guard their way to walk in My law as you have walked before Me.’
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: And now, O LORD, God of Israel, please confirm what You promised to Your servant David.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: But will God indeed dwell with man upon the earth? Even heaven, the highest heaven, cannot contain You, much less this temple I have built.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Yet regard the prayer and plea of Your servant, O LORD my God, so that You may hear the cry and the prayer that Your servant is praying before You.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: May Your eyes be open toward this temple day and night, toward the place where You said You would put Your Name, so that You may hear the prayer that Your servant prays toward this place.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Hear the plea of Your servant and of Your people Israel when they pray toward this place. May You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place. May You hear and forgive.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: When a man sins against his neighbor and is required to take an oath, and he comes to take an oath before Your altar in this temple,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: then may You hear from heaven and act. May You judge Your servants, condemning the wicked man by bringing down on his own head what he has done, and justifying the righteous man by rewarding him according to his righteousness.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: When Your people Israel are defeated before an enemy because they have sinned against You, and they return to You and confess Your name, praying and pleading before You in this temple,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: then may You hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your people Israel. May You restore them to the land You gave to them and their fathers.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: When the skies are shut and there is no rain because Your people have sinned against You, and they pray toward this place and confess Your name, and they turn from their sins because You have afflicted them,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: then may You hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your servants, Your people Israel, so that You may teach them the good way in which they should walk. May You send rain on the land that You gave Your people as an inheritance.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: When famine or plague comes upon the land, or blight or mildew or locusts or grasshoppers, or when their enemies besiege them in their cities, whatever plague or sickness may come,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: then may whatever prayer or petition Your people Israel make—each knowing his own afflictions and spreading out his hands toward this temple—
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: be heard by You from heaven, Your dwelling place. And may You forgive and repay each man according to all his ways, since You know his heart—for You alone know the hearts of men—
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: so that they may fear You and walk in Your ways all the days they live in the land that You gave to our fathers.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: And as for the foreigner who is not of Your people Israel but has come from a distant land because of Your great name and Your mighty hand and outstretched arm—when he comes and prays toward this temple,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: then may You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You. Then all the peoples of the earth will know Your name and fear You, as do Your people Israel, and they will know that this house I have built is called by Your Name.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: When Your people go to war against their enemies, wherever You send them, and when they pray to You in the direction of the city You have chosen and the house I have built for Your Name,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: then may You hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and may You uphold their cause.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: When they sin against You—for there is no one who does not sin—and You become angry with them and deliver them to an enemy who takes them as captives to a land far or near,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: and when they come to their senses in the land to which they were taken, and they repent and plead with You in the land of their captors, saying, ‘We have sinned and done wrong; we have acted wickedly,’
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: and when they return to You with all their heart and soul in the land of the enemies who took them captive, and when they pray in the direction of the land that You gave to their fathers, the city You have chosen, and the house I have built for Your Name,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: then may You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, their prayer and petition, and may You uphold their cause. May You forgive Your people who sinned against You.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Now, my God, may Your eyes be open and Your ears attentive to the prayer offered in this place.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Now therefore, arise, O LORD God, and enter Your resting place, You and the ark of Your might. May Your priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and may Your godly ones rejoice in goodness.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: O LORD God, do not reject Your anointed one. Remember Your loving devotion to Your servant David.
name: Solomon

speaker: israelites
text: For He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
name: The Israelites

speaker: god
text: I have heard your prayer and have chosen this place for Myself as a house of sacrifice.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If I close the sky so there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send a plague among My people,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and if My people who are called by My name humble themselves and pray and seek My face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, forgive their sin, and heal their land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Now My eyes will be open and My ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I have now chosen and consecrated this temple so that My Name may be there forever. My eyes and My heart will be there for all time.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And as for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked, doing all I have commanded you, and if you keep My statutes and ordinances,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: then I will establish your royal throne, as I covenanted with your father David when I said, ‘You will never fail to have a man to rule over Israel.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But if you turn away and forsake the statutes and commandments I have set before you, and if you go off to serve and worship other gods,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: then I will uproot Israel from the soil I have given them, and I will banish from My presence this temple I have sanctified for My Name. I will make it an object of scorn and ridicule among all the peoples.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And when this temple has become a heap of rubble, all who pass by it will be appalled and say, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And others will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—because of this, He has brought all this disaster upon them.’
name: The LORD

speaker: solomon
text: My wife must not live in the house of David king of Israel, because the places the ark of the LORD has entered are holy.
name: Solomon

speaker: queen-of-sheba
text: The report I heard in my own country about your words and wisdom is true.
name: The queen of Sheba

speaker: queen-of-sheba
text: But I did not believe the reports until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not half of the greatness of your wisdom was told to me. You have far exceeded the report I heard.
name: The queen of Sheba

speaker: queen-of-sheba
text: How blessed are your men! How blessed are these servants of yours who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom!
name: The queen of Sheba

speaker: queen-of-sheba
text: Blessed be the LORD your God, who has delighted in you to set you on His throne to be king for the LORD your God. Because your God loved Israel enough to establish them forever, He has made you king over them to carry out justice and righteousness.
name: The queen of Sheba

speaker: israelites
text: Your father put a heavy yoke on us. But now you should lighten the burden of your father’s service and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you.
name: The Israelites

speaker: rehoboam
text: Come back to me in three days.
name: Rehoboam

speaker: rehoboam
text: How do you advise me to respond to these people?
name: Rehoboam

speaker: elders
text: If you will be kind to these people and please them by speaking kind words to them, they will be your servants forever.
name: The elders

speaker: rehoboam
text: What message do you advise that we send back to these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?
name: Rehoboam

speaker: young-men
text: This is how you should answer these people who said to you, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you should make it lighter.’ This is what you should tell them: ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist!
name: The young men

speaker: young-men
text: Whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.’
name: The young men

speaker: rehoboam
text: Come back to me on the third day.
name: Rehoboam

speaker: rehoboam
text: Whereas my father made your yoke heavy, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.
name: Rehoboam

speaker: israelites
text: What portion do we have in David, and what inheritance in the son of Jesse? To your tents, O Israel! Look now to your own house, O David!
name: The Israelites

speaker: god
text: Tell Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah and all the Israelites in Judah and Benjamin
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: that this is what the LORD says: ‘You are not to go up and fight against your brothers. Each of you must return home, for this word is from Me.’
name: The LORD

speaker: shemaiah
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘You have forsaken Me; therefore, I have forsaken you into the hand of Shishak.’
name: Shemaiah the prophet

speaker: judah-leaders
text: The LORD is righteous.
name: The leaders and the king

speaker: god
text: They have humbled themselves; I will not destroy them, but will soon grant them deliverance. My wrath will not be poured out on Jerusalem through Shishak.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Nevertheless, they will become his servants, so that they may learn the difference between serving Me and serving the kings of other lands.
name: The LORD

speaker: abijah
text: Hear me, O Jeroboam and all Israel!
name: Abijah

speaker: abijah
text: Do you not know that the LORD, the God of Israel, has given the kingship of Israel to David and his descendants forever by a covenant of salt?
name: Abijah

speaker: abijah
text: Yet Jeroboam son of Nebat, a servant of Solomon son of David, rose up and rebelled against his master.
name: Abijah

speaker: abijah
text: Then worthless and wicked men gathered around him to resist Rehoboam son of Solomon when he was young, inexperienced, and unable to resist them.
name: Abijah

speaker: abijah
text: And now you think you can resist the kingdom of the LORD, which is in the hands of David’s descendants. You are indeed a vast army, and you have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made for you as gods.
name: Abijah

speaker: abijah
text: But did you not drive out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites? And did you not make priests for yourselves as do the peoples of other lands? Now whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams can become a priest of things that are not gods.
name: Abijah

speaker: abijah
text: But as for us, the LORD is our God. We have not forsaken Him; the priests who minister to the LORD are sons of Aaron, and the Levites attend to their duties.
name: Abijah

speaker: abijah
text: Every morning and every evening they present burnt offerings and fragrant incense to the LORD. They set out the rows of showbread on the ceremonially clean table, and every evening they light the lamps of the gold lampstand. We are carrying out the requirements of the LORD our God, while you have forsaken Him.
name: Abijah

speaker: abijah
text: Now behold, God Himself is with us as our head, and His priests with their trumpets sound the battle call against you. O children of Israel, do not fight against the LORD, the God of your fathers, for you will not succeed.
name: Abijah

speaker: asa
text: Let us build these cities and surround them with walls and towers, with doors and bars. The land is still ours because we have sought the LORD our God. We have sought Him and He has given us rest on every side.
name: Asa

speaker: asa
text: O LORD, there is no one besides You to help the powerless against the mighty. Help us, O LORD our God, for we rely on You, and in Your name we have come against this multitude. O LORD, You are our God. Do not let a mere mortal prevail against You.
name: Asa

speaker: azariah
text: Listen to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin. The LORD is with you when you are with Him. If you seek Him, He will be found by you, but if you forsake Him, He will forsake you.
name: Azariah son of Oded

speaker: azariah
text: For many years Israel has been without the true God, without a priest to instruct them, and without the law.
name: Azariah son of Oded

speaker: azariah
text: But in their distress they turned to the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought Him, and He was found by them.
name: Azariah son of Oded

speaker: azariah
text: In those days there was no safety for travelers, because the residents of the lands had many conflicts.
name: Azariah son of Oded

speaker: azariah
text: Nation was crushed by nation, and city by city, for God afflicted them with all kinds of adversity.
name: Azariah son of Oded

speaker: azariah
text: But as for you, be strong; do not be discouraged, for your work will be rewarded.
name: Azariah son of Oded

speaker: asa
text: Let there be a treaty between me and you, between my father and your father. See, I have sent you silver and gold. Now go and break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that he will withdraw from me.
name: Asa

speaker: hanani
text: Because you have relied on the king of Aram and not on the LORD your God, the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand.
name: Hanani the seer

speaker: hanani
text: Were not the Cushites and Libyans a vast army with many chariots and horsemen? Yet because you relied on the LORD, He delivered them into your hand.
name: Hanani the seer

speaker: hanani
text: For the eyes of the LORD roam to and fro over all the earth, to show Himself strong on behalf of those whose hearts are fully devoted to Him. You have acted foolishly in this matter. From now on, therefore, you will be at war.
name: Hanani the seer

speaker: ahab
text: Will you go with me against Ramoth-gilead?
name: Ahab

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: I am like you, and my people are your people; we will join you in the war.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: Please inquire first for the word of the LORD.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: ahab
text: Should we go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or should we refrain?
name: Ahab

speaker: prophets
text: Go up,
name: The four hundred prophets

speaker: prophets
text: and God will deliver it into the hand of the king.
name: The four hundred prophets

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: Is there not still a prophet of the LORD here of whom we can inquire?
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: ahab
text: There is still one man who can ask the LORD, but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good for me, but only bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah.
name: Ahab

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: The king should not say that!
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: ahab
text: Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once.
name: Ahab

speaker: zedekiah
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘With these you shall gore the Arameans until they are finished off.’
name: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah

speaker: prophets
text: Go up to Ramoth-gilead and prosper, for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.
name: The four hundred prophets

speaker: messenger
text: Behold, with one accord the words of the prophets are favorable to the king. So please let your words be like theirs, and speak favorably.
name: The messenger

speaker: micaiah
text: As surely as the LORD lives, I will speak whatever my God tells me.
name: Micaiah

speaker: ahab
text: Micaiah, should we go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or should we refrain?
name: Ahab

speaker: micaiah
text: Go up and triumph,
name: Micaiah

speaker: micaiah
text: for they will be given into your hand.
name: Micaiah

speaker: ahab
text: How many times must I make you swear not to tell me anything but the truth in the name of the LORD?
name: Ahab

speaker: micaiah
text: I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd. And the LORD said, ‘These people have no master; let each one return home in peace.’
name: Micaiah

speaker: ahab
text: Did I not tell you that he never prophesies good for me, but only bad?
name: Ahab

speaker: micaiah
text: Therefore hear the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on His throne, and all the host of heaven standing on His right and on His left.
name: Micaiah

speaker: micaiah
text: And the LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel to march up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?’ And one suggested this, and another that.
name: Micaiah

speaker: micaiah
text: Then a spirit came forward, stood before the LORD, and said, ‘I will entice him.’ ‘By what means?’ asked the LORD.
name: Micaiah

speaker: micaiah
text: And he replied, ‘I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouths of all his prophets.’ ‘You will surely entice him and prevail,’ said the LORD. ‘Go and do it.’
name: Micaiah

speaker: micaiah
text: So you see, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouths of these prophets of yours, and the LORD has pronounced disaster against you.
name: Micaiah

speaker: zedekiah
text: Which way did the Spirit of the LORD go when He departed from me to speak with you?
name: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah

speaker: micaiah
text: You will soon see, on that day when you go and hide in an inner room.
name: Micaiah

speaker: ahab
text: Take Micaiah and return him to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son,
name: Ahab

speaker: ahab
text: and tell them that this is what the king says: ‘Put this man in prison and feed him only bread and water until I return safely.’
name: Ahab

speaker: micaiah
text: If you ever return safely, the LORD has not spoken through me.
name: Micaiah

speaker: micaiah
text: Take heed, all you people!
name: Micaiah

speaker: ahab
text: I will disguise myself and go into battle, but you wear your royal robes.
name: Ahab

speaker: aram-king
text: Do not fight with anyone, small or great, except the king of Israel.
name: The king of Aram

speaker: chariot-commanders
text: This is the king of Israel!
name: The chariot commanders

speaker: ahab
text: Turn around and take me out of the battle, for I am badly wounded!
name: Ahab

speaker: jehu-son-of-hanani
text: Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD? Because of this, the wrath of the LORD is upon you.
name: Jehu son of Hanani

speaker: jehu-son-of-hanani
text: However, some good is found in you, for you have removed the Asherah poles from the land and have set your heart on seeking God.
name: Jehu son of Hanani

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: Consider carefully what you do, for you are not judging for man, but for the LORD, who is with you when you render judgment.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: And now, may the fear of the LORD be upon you. Be careful what you do, for with the LORD our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: You must serve faithfully and wholeheartedly in the fear of the LORD.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: For every dispute that comes before you from your brothers who dwell in their cities—whether it regards bloodshed or some other violation of law, commandments, statutes, or ordinances—you are to warn them, so that they will not incur guilt before the LORD and wrath will not come upon you and your brothers. Do this, and you will not incur guilt.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: Note that Amariah, the chief priest, will be over you in all that pertains to the LORD, and Zebadiah son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all that pertains to the king. And the Levites will serve as officers before you. Act resolutely; may the LORD be with the upright!
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: A vast army is coming against you from Edom, from beyond the Sea; they are already in Hazazon-tamar
name: Messengers

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: O LORD, God of our fathers, are You not the God who is in heaven, and do You not rule over all the kingdoms of the nations? Power and might are in Your hand, and no one can stand against You.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: Our God, did You not drive out the inhabitants of this land before Your people Israel and give it forever to the descendants of Abraham Your friend?
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: They have lived in the land and have built in it a sanctuary for Your Name, saying,
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: ‘If disaster comes upon us—whether sword or judgment, plague or famine—we will stand before this temple and before You, for Your Name is in this temple. We will cry out to You in our distress, and You will hear us and save us.’
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: And now, here are the men of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, whom You did not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt; but Israel turned away from them and did not destroy them.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: See how they are repaying us by coming to drive us out of the possession that You gave us as an inheritance.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: Our God, will You not judge them? For we are powerless before this vast army that comes against us. We do not know what to do, but our eyes are upon You.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: jahaziel
text: Listen, all you people of Judah and Jerusalem! Listen, King Jehoshaphat! This is what the LORD says: ‘Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army, for the battle does not belong to you, but to God.
name: Jahaziel

speaker: jahaziel
text: Tomorrow you are to march down against them. You will see them coming up the Ascent of Ziz, and you will find them at the end of the valley facing the Wilderness of Jeruel.
name: Jahaziel

speaker: jahaziel
text: You need not fight this battle. Take up your positions, stand firm, and see the salvation of the LORD on your behalf, O Judah and Jerusalem. Do not be afraid or discouraged. Go out and face them tomorrow, for the LORD is with you.’
name: Jahaziel

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: Hear me, O people of Judah and Jerusalem. Believe in the LORD your God, and you will be upheld; believe in His prophets, and you will succeed.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: singers
text: Give thanks to the LORD, for His loving devotion endures forever.
name: The singers

speaker: eliezer
text: Because you have allied yourself with Ahaziah, the LORD has destroyed your works.
name: Eliezer son of Dodavahu

speaker: elijah
text: This is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: ‘You have not walked in the ways of your father Jehoshaphat or of Asa king of Judah,
name: Elijah's letter

speaker: elijah
text: but you have walked in the ways of the kings of Israel and have caused Judah and the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves, just as the house of Ahab prostituted itself. You have also killed your brothers, your father’s family, who were better than you.
name: Elijah's letter

speaker: elijah
text: So behold, the LORD is about to strike your people, your sons, your wives, and all your possessions with a serious blow.
name: Elijah's letter

speaker: elijah
text: And day after day you yourself will suffer from a severe illness, a disease of your bowels, until it causes your bowels to come out.’
name: Elijah's letter

speaker: burial-party
text: He is the grandson of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart.
name: Those who buried him

speaker: jehoiada
text: Behold, the king’s son!
name: Jehoiada

speaker: jehoiada
text: He must reign, just as the LORD promised concerning the descendants of David.
name: Jehoiada

speaker: jehoiada
text: This is what you are to do: A third of you priests and Levites who come on duty on the Sabbath shall keep watch at the doors,
name: Jehoiada

speaker: jehoiada
text: a third shall be at the royal palace, and a third at the Foundation Gate, while all the others are in the courtyards of the house of the LORD.
name: Jehoiada

speaker: jehoiada
text: No one is to enter the house of the LORD except the priests and those Levites who serve; they may enter because they are consecrated, but all the people are to obey the requirement of the LORD.
name: Jehoiada

speaker: jehoiada
text: The Levites must surround the king with weapons in hand, and anyone who enters the temple must be put to death. You must stay close to the king wherever he goes.
name: Jehoiada

speaker: israelites
text: Long live the king!
name: The Israelites

speaker: athaliah
text: Treason, treason!
name: Athaliah

speaker: jehoiada
text: Bring her out between the ranks, and put to the sword anyone who follows her.
name: Jehoiada

speaker: jehoiada
text: She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.
name: Jehoiada

speaker: joash
text: Go out to the cities of Judah and collect the money due annually from all Israel, to repair the house of your God. Do it quickly.
name: Joash

speaker: joash
text: Why have you not required the Levites to bring from Judah and Jerusalem the tax imposed by Moses the servant of the LORD and by the assembly of Israel for the Tent of the Testimony?
name: Joash

speaker: zechariah
text: This is what God says: ‘Why do you transgress the commandments of the LORD so that you cannot prosper? Because you have forsaken the LORD, He has forsaken you.’
name: Zechariah son of Jehoiada

speaker: zechariah
text: May the LORD see this and call you to account.
name: Zechariah son of Jehoiada

speaker: god
text: Fathers must not be put to death for their children, and children must not be put to death for their fathers; each is to die for his own sin.
name: The LORD

speaker: man-of-god
text: O king, do not let the army of Israel go with you, for the LORD is not with Israel—not with any of the Ephraimites.
name: A man of God

speaker: man-of-god
text: Even if you go and fight bravely in battle, God will make you stumble before the enemy, for God has power to help and power to overthrow.
name: A man of God

speaker: amaziah
text: What should I do about the hundred talents I have given to the army of Israel?
name: Amaziah

speaker: man-of-god
text: The LORD is able to give you much more than this.
name: A man of God

speaker: unnamed-prophet
text: Why have you sought this people’s gods, which could not deliver them from your hand?
name: A prophet

speaker: amaziah
text: Have we made you the counselor to the king? Stop! Why be struck down?
name: Amaziah

speaker: unnamed-prophet
text: I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not heeded my advice.
name: A prophet

speaker: amaziah
text: Come, let us meet face to face,
name: Amaziah

speaker: jehoash
text: A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle.
name: Jehoash king of Israel

speaker: jehoash
text: You have said, ‘Look, I have defeated Edom,’ and your heart has become proud and boastful. Now stay at home. Why should you stir up trouble so that you fall—you and Judah with you?
name: Jehoash king of Israel

speaker: azariah-priest
text: Uzziah, you have no right to offer incense to the LORD. Only the priests, the descendants of Aaron, are consecrated to burn incense. Leave the sanctuary, for you have acted unfaithfully; you will not receive honor from the LORD God.
name: Azariah and the priests

speaker: oded
text: Look,
name: Oded the prophet

speaker: oded
text: because of His wrath against Judah, the LORD, the God of your fathers, has delivered them into your hand. But you have slaughtered them in a rage that reaches up to heaven.
name: Oded the prophet

speaker: oded
text: And now you intend to reduce to slavery the men and women of Judah and Jerusalem. But are you not also guilty before the LORD your God?
name: Oded the prophet

speaker: oded
text: Now therefore, listen to me and return the captives you took from your kinsmen, for the fierce anger of the LORD is upon you.
name: Oded the prophet

speaker: ephraimite-leaders
text: You must not bring the captives here,
name: The Ephraimite leaders

speaker: ephraimite-leaders
text: for you are proposing to bring guilt upon us from the LORD and to add to our sins and our guilt. For our guilt is great, and fierce anger is upon Israel.
name: The Ephraimite leaders

speaker: ahaz
text: Because the gods of the kings of Aram have helped them, I will sacrifice to them that they may help me.
name: Ahaz

speaker: hezekiah
text: Listen to me, O Levites,
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Consecrate yourselves now and consecrate the house of the LORD, the God of your fathers. Remove from the Holy Place every impurity.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: For our fathers were unfaithful and did evil in the sight of the LORD our God. They abandoned Him, turned their faces away from the dwelling place of the LORD, and turned their backs on Him.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: They also shut the doors of the portico and extinguished the lamps. They did not burn incense or present burnt offerings in the Holy Place of the God of Israel.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Therefore, the wrath of the LORD has fallen upon Judah and Jerusalem, and He has made them an object of terror, horror, and mockery, as you can see with your own eyes.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: For behold, this is why our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and daughters and wives are in captivity.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD, the God of Israel, so that His fierce anger will turn away from us.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Now, my sons, do not be negligent, for the LORD has chosen you to stand before Him, to serve Him, to minister before Him, and to burn incense.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: levites-report
text: We have cleansed the entire house of the LORD, the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the table of the showbread with all its utensils.
name: The priests and Levites

speaker: levites-report
text: Moreover, we have prepared and consecrated all the articles that King Ahaz in his unfaithfulness cast aside during his reign. They are now in front of the altar of the LORD.
name: The priests and Levites

speaker: hezekiah
text: Now that you have consecrated yourselves to the LORD, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings to the house of the LORD.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Children of Israel, return to the LORD, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, so that He may return to those of you who remain, who have escaped the grasp of the kings of Assyria.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Do not be like your fathers and brothers who were unfaithful to the LORD, the God of their fathers, so that He made them an object of horror, as you can see.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Now do not stiffen your necks as your fathers did. Submit to the LORD and come to His sanctuary, which He has consecrated forever. Serve the LORD your God, so that His fierce anger will turn away from you.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: For if you return to the LORD, your brothers and sons will receive mercy in the presence of their captors and will return to this land. For the LORD your God is gracious and merciful; He will not turn His face away from you if you return to Him.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: May the LORD, who is good, provide atonement for everyone
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: who sets his heart on seeking God—the LORD, the God of his fathers—even if he is not cleansed according to the purification rules of the sanctuary.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: azariah-chief-priest
text: Since the people began to bring their contributions into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat and there is plenty left over, because the LORD has blessed His people; this great abundance is what is left over.
name: Azariah the chief priest

speaker: judah-people
text: Why should the kings of Assyria come and find plenty of water?
name: The people

speaker: hezekiah
text: Be strong and courageous! Do not be afraid or discouraged before the king of Assyria and the vast army with him, for there is a greater One with us than with him.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: With him is only the arm of flesh, but with us is the LORD our God to help us and to fight our battles.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: sennacherib
text: This is what Sennacherib king of Assyria says: What is the basis of your confidence, that you remain in Jerusalem under siege?
name: Sennacherib

speaker: sennacherib
text: Is not Hezekiah misleading you to give you over to death by famine and thirst when he says, ‘The LORD our God will deliver us from the hand of the king of Assyria?’
name: Sennacherib

speaker: sennacherib
text: Did not Hezekiah himself remove His high places and His altars and say to Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You must worship before one altar, and on it you shall burn sacrifices’?
name: Sennacherib

speaker: sennacherib
text: Do you not know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the lands? Have the gods of these nations ever been able to deliver their land from my hand?
name: Sennacherib

speaker: sennacherib
text: Who among all the gods of these nations that my fathers devoted to destruction has been able to deliver his people from my hand? How then can your God deliver you from my hand?
name: Sennacherib

speaker: sennacherib
text: So now, do not let Hezekiah deceive you, and do not let him mislead you like this. Do not believe him, for no god of any nation or kingdom has been able to deliver his people from my hand or from the hand of my fathers. How much less will your God deliver you from my hand!
name: Sennacherib

speaker: sennacherib
text: Just as the gods of the nations did not deliver their people from my hand, so the God of Hezekiah will not deliver His people from my hand.
name: Sennacherib

speaker: god
text: My Name will remain in Jerusalem forever.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will establish My Name forever.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will never again cause the feet of the Israelites to leave the land that I assigned to your fathers, if only they are careful to do all that I have commanded them through Moses—all the laws, statutes, and judgments.
name: The LORD

speaker: hilkiah
text: I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD!
name: Hilkiah

speaker: shaphan
text: Your servants are doing all that has been placed in their hands.
name: Shaphan the scribe

speaker: shaphan
text: They have paid out the money that was found in the house of the LORD and have put it into the hands of the supervisors and workers.
name: Shaphan the scribe

speaker: shaphan
text: Hilkiah the priest has given me a book.
name: Shaphan the scribe

speaker: josiah
text: Go and inquire of the LORD for me and for those remaining in Israel and Judah concerning the words in the book that has been found. For great is the wrath of the LORD that has been poured out on us because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD by doing all that is written in this book.
name: Josiah

speaker: huldah
text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Tell the man who sent you
name: Huldah the prophetess

speaker: huldah
text: that this is what the LORD says: I am about to bring calamity on this place and on its people, according to all the curses written in the book that has been read in the presence of the king of Judah,
name: Huldah the prophetess

speaker: huldah
text: because they have forsaken Me and burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke Me to anger with all the works of their hands. My wrath will be poured out upon this place and will not be quenched.’
name: Huldah the prophetess

speaker: huldah
text: But as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, tell him that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘As for the words that you heard,
name: Huldah the prophetess

speaker: huldah
text: because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before God when you heard His words against this place and against its people, and because you have humbled yourself before Me and you have torn your clothes and wept before Me, I have heard you,’ declares the LORD.
name: Huldah the prophetess

speaker: huldah
text: ‘Now I will indeed gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the calamity that I will bring on this place and on its inhabitants.’
name: Huldah the prophetess

speaker: josiah
text: Put the holy ark in the temple built by Solomon son of David king of Israel. It is not to be carried around on your shoulders. Now serve the LORD your God and His people Israel.
name: Josiah

speaker: josiah
text: Prepare yourselves by families in your divisions, according to the instructions written by David king of Israel and Solomon his son.
name: Josiah

speaker: josiah
text: Moreover, stand in the Holy Place by the divisions of the families of your kinsmen the lay people, and by the divisions of the families of the Levites.
name: Josiah

speaker: josiah
text: Slaughter the Passover lambs, consecrate yourselves, and make preparations for your fellow countrymen to carry out the word of the LORD given by Moses.
name: Josiah

speaker: neco
text: What is the issue between you and me, O king of Judah? I have not come against you today, but I am fighting another dynasty. God told me to hurry; so stop opposing God, who is with me, or He will destroy you!
name: Neco king of Egypt

speaker: josiah
text: Take me away, for I am badly wounded!
name: Josiah

speaker: cyrus
text: This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: ‘The LORD, the God of heaven, who has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, has appointed me to build a house for Him at Jerusalem in Judah. Whoever among you belongs to His people, may the LORD his God be with him, and may he go up.’
name: Cyrus king of Persia
